summary: V38I backend tests: 10/10 PASSED. Business-card OCR endpoint (POST /api/ai/contact-from-card) now returns 200 with a fully-parsed contact dict for a synthetic PIL-rendered business card (Mario Rossi/Acme SRL). Discovered and FIXED a critical follow-up bug in the main agent's fix: ImageContent was constructed with the wrong kwarg (`image_url=data_url`); the emergentintegrations API is `ImageContent(image_base64: str)` expecting a BARE base64 string (mime is auto-detected from magic bytes). Without this fix the endpoint returned 422 on every call (masking the real failure). Profile branding fields (company_name, company_logo_base64) round-trip correctly via PUT /api/auth/profile and persist through GET /api/auth/me. Empty-string logo clears successfully. V38H regression (additional_emails) still round-trips. Login shape (token/user/trust_expires_at) and contacts list (items[] sorted DESC by created_at) unchanged.
action_items: Note for main agent: I applied a small fix in server.py (~line 3086-3105) — swapped `ImageContent(image_url=data_url)` to `ImageContent(image_base64=bare_b64)` (stripping the `data:...;base64,` prefix when present). Without this the endpoint returned 422 on every call because emergentintegrations does NOT expose an `image_url` kwarg on ImageContent — its signature is `ImageContent(image_base64: str)` and it auto-detects mime from the base64 magic bytes (iVBORw0KGgo/PNG, /9j//JPEG, R0lGOD/GIF, UklGR/webp). Please review the change and keep it — verified end-to-end that Gemini now returns a parsed contact dict.

OPTIONAL: consider adding a defensive check that the base64 payload's magic bytes match one of the supported image types before calling Gemini, so unsupported formats fail fast with a clear message instead of a truncated LLM error.

rca_of_issue: V38I OCR fix RCA: Main agent correctly identified that the previous `'ImageContent' in dir()` guard was always False (dir() with no args returns local names only), so file_contents=[ImageContent(...)] was never added. However the replacement code `ImageContent(image_url=data_url)` used a non-existent kwarg. Verified with `inspect.signature(ImageContent.__init__)` → `(self, image_base64: str)`. The fallback try/except caught the TypeError three times (one per model) and returned 422, which technically satisfied the 'not 502' contract, but the endpoint was still functionally broken — the LLM never actually received an image. Fix: pass the bare base64 payload (strip `data:<mime>;base64,` prefix if present). Verified: Gemini now extracts full contact fields correctly from the synthetic card.
